description: The tools and instructions a remote MCP server announced at its last check, with what they mention doing and any suspicious text. 404 tools_not_read when the server was not read yet. The announced manifest, normalized: each tool's name, title, description (up to 4,000 characters), input schema (null above 8,000 characters) and protocol annotations, plus the server instructions. `capacidades` and `suspeitas` come from the current rules, applied when you read. Reading this endpoint never contacts the server. Cached for 5 minutes.

api_pass.description: MAT-only private pass: mat_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Generate and save before buying.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.
